description: This file contains C source code for a telemetry component in a software project. It includes functions for creating, initializing, and removing telemetry objects, managing internal JSON and message pack blobs, and setting object properties. The code appears to be part of a larger system that implements telemetry data handling, with functions that conform to standard object lifecycle patterns in C.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE CosaTelemetryCreate(VOID)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new COSA telemetry object, returning a handle to it.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaTelemetryInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the telemetry object by setting internal blob pointers to NULL.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaTelemetryRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Removes the telemetry object, freeing associated internal memory.
